Lean.Core.CoreM.comment:
CoreM is a monad for manipulating the Lean environment.
It is the base monad for `MetaM`.
The main features it provides are:
- name generator state
- environment state
- Lean options context
- the current open namespace
Lean.Core.CoreM.fullDefinition: abbrev CoreM := ReaderT Context <| StateRefT State (EIO Exception)
Lean.Core.CoreM.description: A monadic structure that allows for manipulation of the Lean environment, providing functionality for name generation, environment state, options context, and current namespace management.

Lean.compileDecl.fullDefinition: def compileDecl (decl : Declaration) : CoreM Unit := do   let opts ← getOptions   let decls := Compiler.getDeclNamesForCodeGen decl   if compiler.enableNew.get opts then     compileDeclsNew decls   let res ← withTraceNode `compiler (fun _ => return m!"compiling old: {decls}") do     return (← getEnv).compileDecl opts decl   match res with   | Except.ok env => setEnv env   | Except.error (KernelException.other msg) =>     checkUnsupported decl -- Generate nicer error message for unsupported recursors and axioms     throwError msg   | Except.error ex =>     throwKernelException ex
Lean.compileDecl.description: A function that compiles a declaration within the Lean environment using a monadic structure designed for such manipulations.

Lean.Core.mkFreshUserName.fullDefinition: def mkFreshUserName (n : Name) : CoreM Name :=   mkFreshNameImp n
Lean.Core.mkFreshUserName.description: A function that generates a new user name in the Lean environment based on a specified base name.
